Catfish Fillets
By: Karlyn Oyama
Published: Thursday, February 11, 2010 - 11:25am

Ingredients




mustard
worcestershire sauce
lemon juice
catfish fillets

Preparation

1 Mix to taste....Coat the fillet with the sauce and place in a grilling basket on your grill. 2 Another way is to go to Cracker Barrel and buy the Cajun Spice Mix they sell and grill in the basket on your grill! 3 NOTES : I love catfish!! This is one of the best ways to fix it.
